How IDs were resolved

Exact family and slice IDs are joined to the supplied Atlas. A two-endpoint same-family equation range is expanded inclusively. The three-endpoint chain F19.1-F19.2-F19.10 is treated as an enumeration. Future-query hints are excluded. No phrase similarity or spatial distance is used.
